children: Ironwood appointed Tammi Gaskins as Chief Executive Officer effective January 1, 2027, as Thomas McCourt will retire as CEO on December 31, 2026 and remain on the Board.
Retirement after 17 years of service (including five years as CEO)
Successor: Tammi Gaskins (appointed CEO effective Jan 1, 2027)
Senior Vice President, Chief Commercial Officer of the Company; further bio incorporated by reference to proxy filed Apr 28, 2026 (page 22)
17 years service to the Company, five years as CEO
Added as director (Board size increased from eight to nine) effective Jan 1, 2027
Will continue to serve as a director after retiring as CEO
